primelase.headline: The fastest laser for hair removal

cooltech.headline: Freeze fat without surgery
cooltech.lead: Cooltech Define — four applicators running at once, nine handpiece templates, 360° cooling to −10 °C. Up to 30 % of the fat layer per session, in 400+ slimming clinics.

inbody.headline: Measure what the scale cannot

affiliate.metaTitle: The owner network — earn on the devices you recommend
affiliate.metaDesc: Buy a device and you open a position in its network. Colleagues who buy on your invite code join it, and you earn a share of the margin on their purchase and on the ones they bring in after that.
affiliate.title: You join it by owning the device
affiliate.lead: There is one programme, and it is not a sign-up form. Buying a device opens your position in that device's network; colleagues who quote your invite code when they buy join it under you, and you earn on their purchase and on the chain they start.
affiliate.how1: Per device: a position in one device's network says nothing about another.
affiliate.how2: One position per person per device — you cannot hold two places in the same tree.
affiliate.how3: Recorded at the sale: our team enters the invite code when payment is taken, so the chain is a record of real purchases rather than sign-ups.
affiliate.how4: Paid by us: commission is settled directly, in person or by transfer, and the amount owed is visible to you and to us on the same ledger.
affiliate.how5: Rates are published per device and are fixed at the moment of each sale — a later change never rewrites what you have already earned.

network.title: The owner network
network.lead: Doctors already recommend equipment to each other. When a colleague buys a device on your invite code, they join your network for that device — and you earn a share of the margin on their purchase, and on the purchases made by the colleagues they bring in after that. You join by owning the device, not by recruiting.

network.step2Body: You are issued an invite code for colleagues to quote when they buy.
network.step3Body: You earn on their purchase, and on the purchases they bring in after that.

matcher.title: Clinical case matcher
matcher.lead: Describe the case and we shortlist the platforms whose indications actually cover it, then hand the clinical reasoning to the assistant — which answers from our device documentation and cites it, rather than guessing.
matcher.placeholder: e.g. 45 y/o female, Fitzpatrick IV, dermal melasma on the cheeks
matcher.needText: Describe the case first — for example “45 y/o, Fitzpatrick IV, dermal melasma”.
matcher.attachedNote: — sent with your case when you open the assistant. Please remove any patient-identifying detail first.
matcher.noMatch: Nothing in the catalogue matched those terms. Ask the assistant directly — it can search the full documentation rather than the indication summaries used here.
matcher.askAi: Ask the assistant about this case
matcher.aiSeed: Case: {{case}}. Is {{device}} the right choice, and what parameters would you start with?
matcher.disclaimer: A shortlist, not a treatment plan. Parameters, contraindications and skin-type safety are the treating physician's decision — our clinical team will review the case with you before purchase.

demand.title: Patient demand simulator
demand.lead: An ROI model assumes you can fill the sessions. This estimates whether your specific catchment can, from population, competitor density and the modality's typical uptake.
demand.addressPlaceholder: Clinic address — e.g. Tehran, Saadat Abad
demand.catchment: Catchment within 5 km: {{people}} · clinics offering the same modality: {{competitors}}
demand.assumptions: Assumes an even split of local demand across clinics offering the modality and typical uptake for this category. Our team refines it with real search-volume and census data for your district before quoting.
demand.cta: Get this in writing with the proforma →

roi.title: Will this device make you money?
roi.lead: Payback, monthly profit and break-even for your own clinic, at a 75 % margin after consumables and staff time. The same model runs inside every device page and on the business plan we attach to your proforma.
roi.quotedNote: This device is quoted rather than listed — your proforma comes with the payback worked out against the quoted price.
roi.planCta: Get the full business plan PDF →
roi.includes: Includes consumables, staffing, local demand and a 7-day Rial lock at the CBI reference rate.
roi.compareLead: Add up to {{max}} machines to see wavelengths, certification, warranty, consumable cost and payback side by side.
roi.useScale: Use the ⚖ button on any device card.
roi.whyBody: the wrong wavelength for a patient's skin type means slower results and a higher risk of post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation. This is the table that prevents it.
